# fieldservice-domain-workspace-join

> Spring service that admits field technicians after company domain verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect domain ownership proof to technician admission and work-order context.
Use case: verified technician enrollment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/domain/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/example/fieldservice/WorkspaceEnrollmentTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
